title: NovaTrade Risk Decision
description: Risk decision contract for the IRB demo run risk engine (Phase 6). Defines the structure returned by RiskEngine.pre_trade_check() and the expanded verdict/action model.

verdict.description: Risk engine verdict. ALLOW = trade may proceed. DENY = trade rejected, trading continues. HALT = trade rejected AND all future trading halted until operator resumes.

checks.description: All risk checks that were evaluated, including passed and failed.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the verdict (empty for ALLOW).

rule.description: Identifier of the first check that triggered denial/halt (empty for ALLOW).

policy_layer.description: Which policy layer produced the verdict. -1 if not applicable (e.g. ALLOW passes all layers). 0=kill_switch, 1=session, 2=drawdown, 3=exposure, 4=pre_trade_gate, 5=strategy_identity.

actions.description: Portfolio-level actions the caller should take in response to this decision. HALT_TRADING is set when the risk engine halts. FLATTEN_POSITIONS and CANCEL_PENDING require monitoring layer support.

drawdown_state.description: Current drawdown state at the time of the decision.

request.description: The OrderRequest that was evaluated (null for portfolio-level checks).

detail.description: Human-readable detail about the check outcome.

daily_drawdown_pct.description: Current daily drawdown as percentage of daily start equity.

total_drawdown_pct.description: Current total drawdown as percentage of initial equity.

PolicyLayer.description: Description of a policy evaluation layer.

on_fail.description: Verdict to return when this layer fails.
